verdicts.reason: Both are unusable. Each puts the forest image as a small strip in the middle of a white banner. The 'March 21' date sits far off on the left in pale yellow on white, which is barely visible. The headline, subtitle and body copy are missing or white-on-white, so the design is lost. B also shows a clipped 'Joint c…' fragment of the subtitle over the image strip. That is a little more content than A has, but it is cut off, so neither is meaningfully better.
